You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

    p['cand']=cand
    print(p['colors'],len(p['shape']),len(cand))
# exact cover recursive, dynamic first uncovered minimizing candidate fits
solutions=[]
def search(uncovered, remaining, chosen):
    if not remaining:
        if not uncovered: solutions.append(chosen.copy())
        return
    if solutions: return
    # choose uncovered cell with fewest feasible candidates
    best=None; opts=None
    for cell in uncovered:
        oo=[]
        for i in remaining:
            p=pieces[i]
            for dr,dc,placed in p['cand']:
                if cell in placed and placed<=uncovered:
                    oo.append((i,dr,dc,placed))
        if not oo: return
        if opts is None or len(oo)<len(opts): best,opts=cell,oo
    for i,dr,dc,placed in opts:
        chosen.append((i,dr,dc))
        search(uncovered-placed,[j for j in remaining if j!=i],chosen)
        chosen.pop()
        if solutions: return
search(frozenset(T),list(range(len(pieces))),[])

D=np.array([[int(x) for x in l.split()] for l in demo1_in.splitlines()])
# General exact tile solver target mask fg, source background

def solve_jigsaw(B,target_slice,source_slice,fg,bg,maxsol=2):
    target=B[target_slice]; source=B[source_slice]
    T=set(map(tuple,np.argwhere(target==fg)))
    lab,n=label(source!=bg)
    ps=[]
    for k,sl in enumerate(find_objects(lab),1):
        coords=[tuple(x) for x in np.argwhere(lab==k)]
        r0=min(r for r,c in coords); c0=min(c for r,c in coords)
        shape=frozenset((r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in coords)
        sub=source[sl]
        colors={(r-r0,c-c0):sub[r-r0,c-c0] for r,c in coords}
        cand=[]
        for dr in range(target.shape[0]):
            for dc in range(target.shape[1]):
                placed=frozenset((r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in shape)
                if placed<=T: cand.append((dr,dc,placed))
        ps.append((shape,colors,cand))
    sols=[]
    def search(unc,rem,chosen):
        if len(sols)>=maxsol:return
        if not rem:
            if not unc:sols.append(chosen.copy())
            return
        opts=None
        for cell in unc:
            oo=[]
            for i in rem:
                for dr,dc,pl in ps[i][2]:
                    if cell in pl and pl<=unc:oo.append((i,dr,dc,pl))
            if not oo:return
            if opts is None or len(oo)<len(opts):opts=oo
        for i,dr,dc,pl in opts:
            chosen.append((i,dr,dc))
            search(unc-pl,[j for j in rem if j!=i],chosen)
            chosen.pop()
    search(frozenset(T),list(range(len(ps))),[])
    outs=[]
    for sol in sols:
        out=np.full(target.shape,bg if bg!=fg else 0,dtype=int)
        # target background value
        vals=target.flatten(); out[:]=vals[0]
        for i,dr,dc in sol:
            for (r,c),v in ps[i][1].items():out[dr+r,dc+c]=v
        outs.append(out)
    return outs
